description: B1 flak divide: an AI CORFLAK and a human ARMATLAS spawned 200 above the flak's exact position and ordered to hover there, on flat ground (Two Continents SW, height 84). CORFLAK_GUN is ballistic + burnblow, so its flight time is hypot(dx,dz) / (v cos pitch) at 0x49CF19, and cos is exactly 0 in the table for a pitch within 0.35 degrees of vertical: stock faults there. Peek the flak's slot-0 pitch (u16 unit+0x1C) while it fires; `tacli crash` names the fault.
